title: Towards Fast and Disentangled Counterfactuals for Visual Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.00895v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation models remain vulnerable to spurious correlations and ``Clever Hans'' strategies. Explainable machine learning can find and remove such strategies for classifiers without metadata. For foundation models, no such option exists yet. We propose Disentangled Diffusion Autoencoders (DiDAE). DiDAE wraps a frozen foundation model in a conditional diffusion decoder. A counterfactual is one closed-form edit along a direction of a disentangled dictionary, followed by decoding. The dictionary can be supervised (Procrustes) or unsupervised (Singular Value Decomposition, Sparse Autoencoders). No gradients are needed, so DiDAE is up to 2000 times faster than the state of the art. We evaluate on six datasets, two synthetic and four real-world. In a desiderata-driven benchmark on three of them, its counterfactuals are on par with or better than the state of the art, and they repair downstream classifiers through Counterfactual Knowledge Disti

translated_title: 面向视觉基础模型的快速解耦反事实生成方法
translated_abstract: 基础模型仍然容易受到虚假关联和“聪明汉斯”策略的影响。可解释机器学习可以为不带元数据的分类器发现并消除此类策略，但对于基础模型，目前尚无此类方法。我们提出了解耦扩散自编码器。DiDAE 将冻结的基础模型封装在条件扩散解码器中。反事实即沿解耦字典方向进行一次闭式编辑，随后进行解码。该字典可以是有监督的（Procrustes 方法）或无监督的（奇异值分解、稀疏自编码器）。由于无需梯度计算，DiDAE 比现有最先进方法快达 2000 倍。我们在六个数据集上进行了评估，其中两个为合成数据集，四个为真实世界数据集。在其中三个数据集上基于需求驱动的基准测试中，其反事实效果与最先进方法相当或更优，并且能够通过反事实知识蒸馏修复下游分类器。
tldr: 提出解耦扩散自编码器DiDAE，通过在解耦字典方向上进行一次无需梯度的闭式编辑即可为冻结的视觉基础模型生成反事实样本，速度比现有最先进方法快达2000倍，并能通过反事实知识蒸馏修复下游分类器中的虚假关联策略。
en_tdlr: DiDAE (Disentangled Diffusion Autoencoders) generates counterfactuals for frozen visual foundation models via a single gradient-free closed-form edit along disentangled dictionary directions—up to 2000x faster than the state of the art—and repairs downstream classifiers through Counterfactual Knowledge Distillation.
